top_findings.title: Factual/runtime gate failed: 'No module named mcp.server.fastmcp' in the probe env
top_findings.evidence: _factual.json note=ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'mcp.server.fastmcp'; server.py:9 imports `from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP`. pyproject.toml:12 correctly declares dependency `mcp>=1.28,<3`, but the retort probe ran under /usr/bin/python3 (3.9.6, no mcp) — the agent's own log item_57 shows a REAL MCP stdio handshake succeeding under python3.11/mcp 1.28.1 (15 tools; dataset_status returned 23854 matches, 18207 players).
top_findings.suggestion: Harness/tooling gap: install the run's declared dependencies (`pip install mcp>=1.28,<3` or `pip install .`) into the factual-probe interpreter, and use a >=3.10 interpreter per requires-python. Code is correct; re-probe should pass.
